address: Address Residences, Opera District, Downtown Dubai, Dubai
bio: This Chinese restaurant is an opulent escape in the heart of Downtown Dubai. Take your pick between an elegant, Regency-inspired dining room known as the Parlour, a club-like room like the Library or a seat in the terrace under the twinkling Burj Khalifa. Once seated, a charming team will guide you through a classic Chinese menu, with tasty dishes ranging from dim sum, golden shrimp on toast or the ever-so loved sweet and sour chicken. If you don’t want the hassle of choosing your dishes, a set tasting menu is also available....
